sources.title: Lukowski Lab
headings: Harnessing the chemistry of life one enzyme at a time
sources.text: Welcome to the Lukowski Lab Harnessing the chemistry of life one enzyme at a time We aim to understand the enzymatic processes underlying natural product biosynthesis and explore their biocatalytic potential in an inclusive, collaborative, and multidisciplinary research environment. We use techniques in enzymology, chemical analysis, and bioinformatics to identify and characterize new enzymes for their substrate scopes and reactivities with a goal of promoting drug discovery through biocatalyst-driven medicinal chemistry.

sources.title: About Us — Lukowski Lab
headings: We opened our doors at the Scripps Institution of Oceanography in October 2023.
sources.text: About Us We opened our doors at the Scripps Institution of Oceanography in October 2023. The Lukowski Lab at UC San Diego is located in Sverdrup Hall on the Scripps Institution of Oceanography campus. We are affiliated with the Center for Marine Biotechnology and Biomedicine (CMBB) at SIO and the Skaggs School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences at UC San Diego. Our Mission To conduct research at the interface of natural products biosynthesis and biocatalysis in a creative and inclusive research environment. Our Core Values Teamwork: As a research group, we are a team. Although we may work on different projects, we support each other and are working toward a common goal. We promote an inclusive environment where everyone's voice is heard and valued. Scientific Rigor: We have high standards for our science. We are creative and thoughtful in our approach and strive for transparency. We evaluate data with a critical eye and we understand that negative results are informative results. Collaboration: We are surrounded by extraordinary researchers with ideas that may complement our own and we see this as an opportunity for building community. Working with others has the potential to take everyone's research to the next level. Growth: Academic research is based on learning and teaching. We see pushing our boundaries and getting out of our comfort zones as a route to promote personal and professional growth.
